description: What is in the sky from a place at a date (default: now): day, twilight or night; the Sun with its next rise, set and twilights; the Moon with its phase, illuminated share, rise and set; each planet with its altitude, direction, brightness (magnitude), constellation and whether it can be seen with the naked eye; and the bright named stars above the horizon. For "what can I see tonight", give the evening time.

height_m.description: Observer height above sea level, m.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "Europe/Paris".

name: perigee_sky
title: The sky from a place
